summary:
Owner-requested one-video intake: primary metadata verifies Capturing Christianity Over 100 Arguments for the Existence of God, Qi7ANgO2ZBU, 2021-02-25, Chad McIntosh presentation. Existing youtube-corpus CLI ingested English auto captions without ASR (13208 segments), exported per-video source-span.json under ignored use-case-output/youtube-100-arguments, no shared export overwritten. Original 359-page Google Slides PDF, directly linked by video description, has searchable text; two fetches match SHA256 56c16fa056ab859c927ee73efdcc2b9e6caa61074274ed91868336d09b2aba91. Materialized four PDF slices: foundation pp9–26, unity pp206–213, reality pp272–291, semantics pp299–302; also bounded dependence/unity/intelligibility/knowability auto-caption spans. PDF p206 rendered/visually checked; no video-frame/audio comparison claimed. Existing OCR detector unavailable (#71); no OCR pipeline fabricated or implemented, no large video/ASR/GPU job. Initial en-orig stream lacked language label, so only subsequent genuine en stream is pinned. Precise reuse map, timestamps, reference leads and rejected duplicate readings appended to docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md. Strong next lead: Bonevac #128 pp299–300/reference pp215–237 on semantic-content anchors; determine whether objective stable content requires a transcendent mind beyond meaningful-denial entitlement. Unity #84 external fact-unifier likewise needs same rigid/numerically unique witness, not just one per world. Rejected: presentation as direct reading of cited authors; #4 anti-infinite-series premise as independently defended; necessary fact explanation as necessary concrete bearer; facts/cosmos/wholes unity as one meaning; knowability quantifier swap as established. No new claim, Lean theorem or philosophical premise discharge. No new source kinds/transcript enums/dependencies. Shared convention sourceRevision c104800c7aaeaea12d56f9093e71bdef6a2ce6fa.

SOURCE-ACCESS / SEMANTIC-CONTENT APPENDIX (2026-10-31; bounded follow-up, not a full-chapter reading). Target: presentation #128, original PDF pp299–300, and its connection to DEF-ELENCTIC-FIRST-PRINCIPLE-DEFENSE/STMT-PNC-ELENCTICALLY-DEFENSIBLE and the existing performed-denial/PSRSelfApplication.bridgeLadder boundary. The source-search step is BLOCKED on obtaining a legitimate full primary chapter, while the earlier intake remains succeeded. Publisher chapter DOI 10.1093/oso/9780190842215.003.0014; publisher abstract URL https://academic.oup.com/book/11666/chapter-abstract/160605180 . Official metadata reports pp215–238, whereas the slide says215–237 and author CV/printed table of contents says214–237. Preserve this edition/pagination discrepancy until actual chapter bytes/edition are inspected; do not silently normalize the page boundary.

Access checks: urllib requests to https://academic.oup.com/book/11666/chapter/160605180 , its chapter-PDF route https://academic.oup.com/book/11666/chapter/160605180/chapter-pdf/40204906/oso-9780190842215-chapter-14.pdf , and https://doi.org/10.1093/oso/9780190842215.003.0014 each returned HTTP403. The guessed PDF filename is an access probe, not a verified actual download URL. Browser full/abstract open redirected to an unavailable Oxford Silverchair minimal page. The search tool exposed official publisher abstract and metadata; that is orientation evidence only, not materialized chapter text. Legitimate publisher/distributor preview https://api.pageplace.de/preview/DT0400.9780190842239_A35486856/preview-9780190842239_A35486856.pdf has51 physical pages and its table of contents lists the chapter, but the preview does not contain its214ff pages. University author profile https://liberalarts.utexas.edu/southasia/faculty/bonevac and official CV https://minio.la.utexas.edu/colaweb-prod/person_files/0/587/BonevacCV2025.pdf confirm publication, not the missing argument. No accessible author full-text version was located by exact-title/author searches. https://danielbonevac.com did not resolve in the access probe; it was a guessed site, not an established author host. A book-text mirror at dokumen.pub and a secondary dissertation were surfaced by search but were not accepted as legitimate primary witnesses or materialized. Their snippets are not source evidence. No chapter claim, source record or bibliographic witness is created from those snippets. A bibliographic record would still require reading the actual edition, which did not occur.

Scope discriminator from the official ABSTRACT ONLY: it frames content and knowledge as infinitary/normative, contrasts finite dispositions with content, and presents an infinite set of finite minds alongside an infinite mind; pragmatism remains a rival whose failure is conditional. This is a reason to seek the primary argument against that rival, not permission to declare the rival refuted or to attribute all details of the slide to Bonevac. In particular the abstract gives no checked inference to NecessaryAt of one rigid concrete bearer, uniqueness, or underivedness. The materialized slide itself concludes probable theism, not a demonstrated necessary concrete mind.

Open-commitment reconstruction (analyst appraisal, no new source attribution): (a) actual meaningful reference/knowledge; (b) its determining semantic content is objective, normative, infinitary and stable across relevant times/modal variations; (c) neither finite dispositions, impersonal content/relations nor a suitably ideal/infinite community adequately grounds those determinations; (d) the adequate ground is a real causally efficacious infinite mind; (e) its content-grounding role entails the existence of that SAME bearer at every relevant accessible world; (f) competing minds cannot each satisfy that role. The existing retorsion licenses a determinate signification concession in the performed discourse, not automatically (b)–(f). Infinitary correctness is not an actually inspected infinite list; finite rules may specify unbounded applications, leaving normativity/unique interpretation to be defended. One objective repeatable content does not alone select one numerically unique mind. Temporal/modal stability of content is not de re necessity of its ground unless the SAME-witness/sustenance interface (e) is independently established. Merely necessary contents and contingent thinkers do not decide what grounds those contents.

Precise next reading question: how does the primary chapter exclude ideal/infinite finite-mind pragmatism and impersonal semantic realism, and why must a transcendent ground be a concrete infinite mind rather than a normative/abstract structure? Only after that can the necessity-of-the-same-ground bridge be tested. Strong positive case retained: a denial of all determinate reference itself must refer determinately to present a reasoned denial; an account of normativity must explain correctness beyond the actual dispositions it describes. This defeats a blanket elimination of the practice, not every naturalistic or impersonal account of its conditions. The independently defended first-principle concession therefore remains usable without pretending it has already discharged the semantic-metaphysical bridges. Actual premise reduction zero. No new proof, model, vocabulary, source claim or handoff edit; only this existing attempt updated.

FOUNDATION SOURCE-ORDER / REUSE AUDIT (2026-11-01; preparation only, no source claims). Materialized and read the FULL existing CAPTURING-CHRISTIANITY-100-SLIDES-FOUNDATION witness, original presentation PDF pp.9–26, raw PDF SHA25656c16fa056ab859c927ee73efdcc2b9e6caa61074274ed91868336d09b2aba91 and selected-range text SHA256cb091fd691bd402bfcc2d91b81ed7bb3c22a659e870fc5a276e3eefff66ca84f. Physical-page map: p.9 #4 Clarke-ish outline, p.10 references; p.11 #5 Leibniz outline; pp.12/13 #6 Davis–Craig outline/references; pp.14/15 #7 Pruss outline/references; pp.16/17 #8 Gale–Pruss outline/references; pp.18/19 #9 Katz–Kremer PPE outline/references; p.20 #10 mereological axioms, p.21 causation, p.22 lemmas/theorem, p.23 simplified outline, p.24 references; pp.25/26 #11 Pruss–Rasmussen outline/references. Attribution is to McIntosh’s presentation ONLY. The named Clarke/Leibniz/Davis/Craig/Pruss/Koons/Katz/Kremer/Pruss–Rasmussen books and papers were not newly read by this audit; slide citations do not supply their primary-source claims.

First coherent extraction proposal: SEVEN substantive qualified readings in source order, confined to p.9 #4 and p.11 #5. (1) p.9 #4 steps1–2: dependent population and self-or-another exhaustion. (2) steps3–4: no self-dependence and the asserted other-dependence inference; retain that the slide’s step4 cites1,2, omitting its no-self step3, rather than silently repairing the displayed reference. (3) step5: anti-infinite-series premise, asserted without independent defense in this range. (4) steps6–7: finite-series-to-independent-terminus conditional and displayed conclusion. (5) p.11 #5 steps1–3: existence/sufficient-reason dichotomy and world-existence application. (6) step4(a–b): world as all contingent beings and exclusion of a reason in its parts individually OR collectively. (7) steps5–6: outside-world necessary reason and existence conclusion. Future claim locators must begin with the exact admitted prefix original presentation PDF pp.9–26: and append physical page, argument number and steps. No claims were created by this planning audit. After actual accepted extraction of this batch, the same candidate should advance to p.12 #6, not mark all18pages attributed or complete.

Exact conditional reuse: STMT-WHOLE-ROSTER-NOT-TRAPPED and WHOLE-ROSTER-ROOT-EQUIVALENCE / TruthCore.Results.Causality.WholeRosterRootEquivalence.equivalence compare whole-roster nontrapping with an actual selected root under actual concrete population and EM. TruthCore.Results.Causality.WholeRosterFoundation.actualRootExists supplies the selected root from population/nontrapping/EM; necessaryActualRoot additionally retains STMT-EVERY-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED-AT. These are not an independent defense of the slide’s anti-infinity premise. Dependent is not automatically modal ContingentAt; independent is not automatically a necessary concrete bearer. Literal no-self dependence does not alone exclude indirect cycles without transitivity or explicit path semantics. The slide does not define that graph/domain correspondence, actual concrete guards or explanatory adequacy. Whole-roster nontrapping tests Set.univ, not all subsets or all-branch WF; its verified equivalence audits the supplied interface’s exact strength rather than proving its reality correspondence.

For #5, TruthCore.Explanation.PSRStrength.ExistencePSR is reusable fact-reason vocabulary at a selected world. Existing STMT-PSR-EXISTENCE-COMPONENT instead quantifies all worlds and does not include the slide’s contingent/necessary bearer dichotomy: it is not an exact source alias. NECESSARY-CAUSE-FROM-CONTINGENT-COVERAGE / TruthCore.Results.Causality.ContingentTotalityCause.necessaryCause and NECESSARY-BEING-FROM-CONTINGENT-COVERAGE already preserve the SAME necessary causal bearer from STMT-A1-COVERED-CONTINGENTS plus STMT-A1-EXTERNAL-WHOLE-CAUSE. A reason is not thereby an actual concrete cause, and the slide’s parts exclusion does not automatically supply those guards, all-subsets WF or a no-single-act-self-production theorem. No existing theorem or open typed interface is newly attributed to the presentation merely because it can support a stronger analyst application.

Remaining full-range distinctions / next sequence: pp.12–15 (#6–7) are the next coherent batch after #4–5. #6 p.12 step4 explicitly supplies universe-explanation-to-God naming as a premise, not an independent derivation. #7 p.14 steps1–5 concern contingent FACT coverage, a contingent aggregate fact and a noncontingent explanation; a necessary fact is not a necessary concrete bearer. PSRStrength.ContingentPSR and BCCFAt, PSR-STRENGTH-MAP / TruthCore.Results.Explanation.PSRStrength.strengthMap and BCCF-DERIVATIVE-REPLY / TruthCore.Results.Explanation.BCCFDerivative.derivativeReply are exact vocabulary/conditional controls, not premise truth; BCCFAt alone does not assert contingency of its aggregate. Then pp.16–19 (#8–9): #8 p.16 step1 covers ALL true propositions, while existing PSRStrength.WeakPSR only covers contingent facts. Its steps3–5 move from a possible explaining proposition to actual explanation with a necessary being under an S5 label; neither a fixed actual explanans nor the SAME rigid necessary bearer follows merely from the label or the weaker typed premise. #9 p.18 PPE and step5 conclude reasonable belief, not actual existence; no exact existing PPE theorem was found by the bounded search. Then pp.20–24 (#10): p.21 C2 conflates numerical distinction with nonoverlap; existing TruthCore.Mereology.UniversalFusionBoundary.Overlap, DistinctCause and OutsideCause preserve the distinctions. P.22 L1 from A4/K requires modal part persistence or rigid parthood/domain scope, not merely actual-world part existence. The displayed wholly-contingent definition must not silently inherit actuality or necessary-part clauses from an unread cited edition. No existing complete Koons eight-axiom derivation was found; ContingentTotalityCause is the guarded external-cause suffix only. Finally pp.25–26 (#11): concrete explicitly means possibly cause-capable, not simply physical. Plural existence-fact explanation-to-necessary-concrete-bearer is a substantive displayed bridge; abstract reasons are not concrete bearers by renaming.

The presentation displays premises and argument outlines but supplies no independent warrant here for its anti-infinity, whole-parts exclusion, modal actuality/explanans transport or reason-to-bearer bridges. This is not a new objection to the owner’s foundation commitment or a verdict on infinite borrowing’s adequacy. It selects the next source-reading/extraction work without starting another premise-defense queue. Premise comparison: none; no philosophical premise, truth status or frontier obligation discharged. No new claim/definition, Lean theorem/model, source pin/kind, dependency or global check was introduced. The earlier Bonevac source-access blocker and all prior intake history remain unchanged. These findings belong in this existing intake attempt; the source candidate should advance only after separately authorized substantive extraction.
